title: Guarded Agent Runtime
instructions: Implement `Registry.add`, `canonical`, `execute_tool` and `run_agent` in `agent_runtime.py` (the dataclasses and the `Model` protocol are provided). `execute_tool` never raises: every failure becomes an `ERROR ...` observation. `run_agent` runs think, act, observe with ordered guards (deadline, budget before the tool runs, loop detection on canonical arguments, per-tool caps) and always ends with an explicit stop reason.

evidence.label: canonical ignores key order and whitespace, and falls back to raw text for invalid JSON
A tool call followed by a final answer stops with "final" and records the trace
Loop detection survives whitespace and key-order changes
A per-tool max_calls cap applies even when arguments differ
The token budget is checked before the tool executes
The deadline uses the injected clock
Unknown tool, bad arguments, timeout, denial and handler errors become ERROR observations without leaking details
An approval callback lets a sensitive tool run
Long observations are truncated before they enter the history
The run stops with max_steps when the step limit is reached
